audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named the abilities but carried no cooldown numbers, so 'respect the taunt' had no window attached.
audit.why: Shield of Durand is 18/17/16/15/14s and Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7s; Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s. Those numbers turn 'wait' into a countable window.
audit.corrected: 18s taunt and 11s punch written into spikes[0], dosFull[1] and breakdown.cooldowns; 180s Hero's Entrance into spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Justice Punch was repeatedly called Galio's W (it is E, the knockup dash); the taunt is Shield of Durand (W). breakdown.cooldowns had it flatly wrong. Meditate's channel being cancelled by the taunt and by the Hero's Entrance knockup was never stated, while breakdown.mid actively told the player to channel W in that window.
audit.why: Galio's E knocks up the first champion hit and his W taunts on release; both are hard CC and Meditate is a channel, so either cancels it. Hero's Entrance lands with a knockup and does the same. Alpha Strike's untargetable window is the answer to the punch-into-taunt chain. Galio's passive Colossal Smash is an auto reset, so the wind-up, not a cast, is the tell.
audit.corrected: Names fixed to Justice Punch (E) / Shield of Durand (W); Meditate cancellation stated in spikes[0], spikes[1], mid, breakdown.mid and report[5]; Alpha Strike untargetable dodge stated in whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns mislabelled the punishable cooldown and gave no duration.

edits.before: Track his W (Justice Punch / the taunt) above all — it's his only hard lock on me. Note when he uses it on the wave or a trade; that's your window to step up safely.
edits.after: Track Shield of Durand (W), his taunt — 18s at rank 1, 14s maxed. It's his only hard lock on me, and when he spends it on the wave that whole window is yours to step up.

edits.before: At 4-5 my short trades get real once Wuju Style true damage and Meditate sustain are online — I can Alpha Strike in, get a couple of E-empowered autos, and W to heal off his Q poke. But at 6 his W taunt and global R make committing to an all-in a trap; I respect the taunt and keep scaling rather than forcing.
edits.after: At 4-5 my short trades get real once Wuju Style true damage and Meditate sustain are online — I Alpha Strike in, land E-empowered autos, then heal only after his taunt is spent, because Shield of Durand and Justice Punch both cancel the channel. At 6 his global R makes an all-in a trap; I respect the taunt and keep scaling.

edits.before: Wait until he's used the taunt on the wave or a bad trade, then step up; without W he can't lock you and your DPS wins the exchange.
edits.after: Wait until Shield of Durand goes on the wave — 18s at rank 1 — then step up; without the taunt he can't lock you and your DPS wins.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable blink lets Yi go through Galio's W taunt window to dodge the lock; Wuju Style's true damage ignores Galio's stacked magic resist; Meditate out-sustains his Q poke and passive chip in a drawn-out fight.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetable blink lets Yi go through Galio's W taunt window to dodge the lock; Wuju Style's true damage ignores Galio's stacked magic resist; Meditate heals through Q chip but the taunt or Hero's Entrance cancels the channel outright.

edits.before: EVEN (5/10) — Galio bullies the early lane but has no answer to an itemized on-hit Yi; survive to your items and the lane is yours, matching the 51.85% win rate.
edits.after: EVEN (5/10) — Galio bullies the early lane but has no answer to an itemized on-hit Yi; the 45.19% win rate is the cost of everyone who fights before their items.

edits.after: Level 3 evens: Wuju Style true damage lets you trade back between Winds of War casts.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour Galio because his Justice Punch taunt combo hard-locks you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his: Justice Punch (E) knocks you up into the Shield of Durand taunt.

edits.before: With two items you out-duel him cleanly by dodging Justice Punch and shredding his shields.
edits.after: With two items you out-duel him — Alpha Strike goes untargetable through his punch and taunt.

edits.before: Galio pokes hard with Winds of War and his W passive magic-shield makes him spongy; his real threat is Justice Punch into taunt, which locks you in place — never Alpha Strike onto him with his E and W up.
edits.after: Galio pokes with Winds of War every 11s and Justice Punch (E) knocks you into the Shield of Durand taunt — that chain also cancels Meditate outright, so never channel W until his E or taunt is spent.

edits.before: His level 6 is scary because Hero's Entrance is a global engage, and even in lane his taunt plus knockup can chain you long enough for his burst — this phase stays his.
edits.after: His level 6 is Hero's Entrance, a 180s global engage whose landing knockup also cancels Meditate mid-channel; in lane the taunt plus that chain buys his burst — the phase stays his.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 swing back to Galio: his Justice Punch knockup into Shield of Durand taunt is a hard lockdown that chains you for his damage, and at 6 his global ult makes fighting him a coinflip, so respect the taunt and just farm.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 swing back to Galio: Justice Punch (E, 11s) knocks you up into the Shield of Durand taunt (W, 18s), and both cancel Meditate mid-channel, so heal only after one is spent. At 6 Hero's Entrance adds a global, so respect the taunt and farm.
